inao-denom-439.note: Chablis Grand Cru is one appellation with seven named climats. La Moutonne spans parts of Vaudésir and Les Preuses; its own boundary is unavailable. Its vineyard location shows both containing climats in full, while this overview shows the whole Grand Cru appellation.

villages.coverageNote: Chablis has 40 Premier Cru climats. This map has eight named boundaries and partial coverage of Fourchaume and Mont de Milieu; 30 named boundaries are unavailable. Wines from missing or partial areas show the broad Premier Cru area. All seven Grand Cru climats are mapped; producer holdings and La Moutonne have no separate boundary.

inao-denom-1024.note: The full Petit Chablis production area spans 17 current communes. Official eligibility areas can overlap other Chablis tiers; no area has been subtracted to make the map disjoint.

inao-denom-2829.note: Vézelay is a white-wine appellation across Asquins, Saint-Père, Tharoiseau and Vézelay. This is the whole appellation area; individual named vineyards are not mapped separately.
